explanation: Three-module, gradient-free adapter. Layer 13 MLP adds an independent-verification cue through a wrong-guess readout constrained to be orthogonal to plain and correct-guess mean inputs. Layers 15 and 19 attention outputs use rank-8 corrections derived from the original copying/counter-copying output maps, with dominant plain-question directions and safe conditional means projected out. Directions were checked across factual categories, alternative guess phrasings, and answer-prefix positions. Magnitudes were calibrated using exact local effects on unedited module inputs and first-order logit-lens estimates. No edited-model execution, gradients, optimizers, or iterative loss fitting were used.
